dump_schema.record_index: kernel writes at rayid * STRIDE (rayid = per-launch ray number; no worldid term). With per-world single launch the test reads (world, cam*PIXELS+pixel) from that world's own readback (equivalent). Multi-world single launch would write every world onto the same rayid range and silently overwrite each other (diagnostic data invalid; rendering values unaffected) -- documented constraint.
